$comment: The known differences between the Figma library and code (first full read, 2026-11-15). pnpm check:figma-parity fails on a difference that is not here, and on an entry whose difference is gone: fix the difference, then delete its entry, so this list only shrinks. An entry needs a reason a reviewer can check and the issue that removes it. Fix list: hds#1565.

name-mismatch:TabsTrigger.reason: Figma fix: rename the Figma component to the code name (hds#1565, F3).

name-mismatch:ToastProvider.reason: Code raises a toast with useToast() under ToastProvider; the Figma Toast is one toast (figma/code-connect.json, exempt). Needs a decision on what the Figma Toast links to: hds#1565, Figma fix F9.

tag-not-on-component:Form.reason: Code fix: point the @figma tag at the component set (hds#1565, code fix C2).

axis-not-in-figma:CodeBlock:variant.reason: Figma fix: draw the axis as a variant property (hds#1565, F4).

axis-not-in-figma:InlineCode:density.reason: Figma fix: draw the axis as a variant property (hds#1565, F4).

default-mismatch:Input:Size.reason: Figma fix: make the default variant the code default (hds#1565, F8).

property-not-in-code:Table:Sortable.reason: Figma fix: remove or rename the property so it maps to a prop; or record the reason in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F6).

property-name:Table:StickyHeader.reason: Figma fix: rename the property to the naming contract (hds#1565, F7).

property-name:Button:Trail Icon.reason: Figma fix: rename the property to the naming contract (hds#1565, F7).

axis-not-in-figma:Button:tone.reason: Button draws tone as the modes of the Figma variable collection "Button tone", not as a variant (owner decision 2026-11-05; check-figma-components holds that shape). The collection has no tokens yet: hds#1565, Figma fix F2.

property-name:Callout:Show Action.reason: Figma fix: rename the property to the naming contract (hds#1565, F7).

property-name:EmptyState:Description2.reason: Figma fix: rename the property to the naming contract (hds#1565, F7).

nesting-mismatch:EmptyState:Button.reason: Sample content in the Figma component: the code takes this part as children. Figma fix: mark it as a slot (hds#1565, F10).

axis-not-in-figma:Progress:variant.reason: Figma fix: draw the axis as a variant property (hds#1565, F4).

axis-not-in-figma:Progress:tone.reason: Figma fix: draw the axis as a variant property (hds#1565, F4).

default-mismatch:Skeleton:Variant.reason: Figma fix: make the default variant the code default (hds#1565, F8).

property-not-in-code:ToastProvider:Descr.reason: Code raises a toast with useToast() under ToastProvider; the Figma Toast is one toast (figma/code-connect.json, exempt). Needs a decision on what the Figma Toast links to: hds#1565, Figma fix F9.

property-not-in-code:ToastProvider:Tone.reason: Code raises a toast with useToast() under ToastProvider; the Figma Toast is one toast (figma/code-connect.json, exempt). Needs a decision on what the Figma Toast links to: hds#1565, Figma fix F9.

property-not-in-code:ToastProvider:Dismi.reason: Code raises a toast with useToast() under ToastProvider; the Figma Toast is one toast (figma/code-connect.json, exempt). Needs a decision on what the Figma Toast links to: hds#1565, Figma fix F9.

axis-not-in-figma:CardProgress:tone.reason: Figma fix: draw the axis as a variant property (hds#1565, F4).

property-not-in-code:SheetDescription:De.reason: Figma fix: remove or rename the property so it maps to a prop; or record the reason in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F6).

property-not-in-code:SheetTitle:Title.reason: Figma fix: remove or rename the property so it maps to a prop; or record the reason in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F6).

axis-not-in-figma:List:variant.reason: Figma fix: draw the axis as a variant property (hds#1565, F4).

nesting-mismatch:Dock:Button.reason: Sample content in the Figma component: the code takes this part as children. Figma fix: mark it as a slot (hds#1565, F10).

property-not-in-code:ListItem:Leading ic.reason: Figma fix: remove or rename the property so it maps to a prop; or record the reason in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F6).

property-not-in-code:ListGroup:Variant.reason: Figma fix: remove or rename the property so it maps to a prop; or record the reason in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F6).

property-not-in-code:ListGroup:Divider.reason: Figma fix: remove or rename the property so it maps to a prop; or record the reason in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F6).

collection-not-in-code:Button tone.reason: Hand-built in Figma for the condensed Button (hds#1147). No token builds it, so check:figma-drift ignores it. Move its values to tokens or accept it as Figma-only: hds#1565, Figma fix F2.

name-mismatch:FormField.reason: Figma fix: rename the Figma component to the code name (hds#1565, F3).

icon-missing-in-figma:Icon:10-289b8e25.reason: Figma fix: draw the icons the code set added (hds#1565, F1).

icon-missing-in-code:Icon:27-a233c236.reason: Figma fix: rename or archive the icons the code set no longer has (lucide renames, hds#1565, F1).

option-not-in-figma:Stack:Gap:18-27ce865.reason: Figma fix: draw the missing options, or record them as codeOnly in figma/code-connect.json (hds#1565, F5).
